status: development specification before v4 outcomes; previously inspected cohorts, not preregistration
residualization: training-only standardization and least squares on [1, anchor, anchor squared]; not conditional independence or causal adjustment
objective: mean pairwise logistic loss on positive-negative training pairs plus ridge*||beta||^2/2
protection: within a fitted model, anchor differences larger than 2*eta cannot reverse under any correction; no guarantee for ambiguous pairs or overall AUC
selection: mean inner-fold AUC, ties within 1e-12 prefer eta=0 then listed smaller eta and larger ridge; every preprocessing fit confined to inner training patients
comparators: all multi-feature methods use the same T plus static/dynamic inputs, except declared extra-only and static-only ablations; T and original uHNDI preserved as fixed strong scores
primary_metric: arithmetic mean of within-outer-fold AUC, followed by equal-weight cohort macro average; report every seed and paired differences
secondary_metrics: pooled OOF AUC with fold-scale caveat
raw T and uHNDI full-record descriptive AUC
performance_target: positive macro delta versus T and original uHNDI in primary seed and every predefined seed, positive mean delta in each cohort; this is development split stability, not independent confirmation
feature_policy: label-independent fixed summaries; no CRS-R, demographic metadata, diagnosis, filenames, source classifier confidence or other release annotations as input

binder.features: whole-stimulus band means plus window/background contrasts, late channel dispersion and posterior/front contrast; ITPC is already phase-consistency, not voltage

wielek.features: other-stage occupancy; conditional persistence and mean/max dwell per stage, normalized transition entropy, switch rate, within-contiguous-segment occupancy variability
wielek.boundaries: never bridge time_record changes, missing epochs or nonconsecutive time values

mendeley.features: static log band ratios and regional fractions; chronological clean 4-second-block quantiles, IQR and differences/autocorrelation of log band ratios; never bridge artifact gaps
mendeley.source: v3 byte-fingerprinted chronological raw block cache, plus original channel-power store; no new EDF exclusions

historical_policy: preserve historical manuscripts, hndi_benchmark, binder_itpc_v1 and gain_necessity_v3 byte for byte
reporting: retain every model and negative result; no best-seed headlines, label inversion after evaluation, acceptance assertions, or novelty priority claim
